question: Can probability-mass-aware latent support matching improve the C162 proper-measure probability on frozen C161 trajectories enough to meet ASCENT/B0 NLL and Brier without a gate, residual, temperature, or probability-head tuning?

hypotheses.primary: Weighting each latent B0-to-C161 permutation by the actor's full B0 probability measure will preserve high-mass mode correspondence better than uniform mode averaging and will improve NLL/Brier over C162 TPMO in both folds.
hypotheses.mechanism: The C162 assignment posterior scores each bijection by an unweighted mean support cost. C165 replaces that surrogate with the exact B0-mass-weighted expected transport cost, then applies the unchanged TPMO proper-measure proximal operator.
rivals: The residual calibration gap is caused by C161 support labels rather than the assignment surrogate.
B0 mass is too diffuse for probability-aware matching to identify stable correspondences.
Mass-aware matching improves NLL/Brier only by degrading Energy sharpness.
hypotheses.null: The frozen C165 candidate fails any gate and closes without changing the operator, controls, or metric definitions.

algorithm.name: MABPT
algorithm.full_name: Mass-Aware Bayesian Permutation Transport with TPMO
algorithm.base_measure: frozen target-free C162 B0 probability vector
algorithm.support: frozen C161 five-trajectory support and C161 predicted risk
algorithm.assignment_posterior: softmax over all 120 bijections with negative B0-probability-weighted expected cross-support cost
algorithm.assignment_temperature: implicit fixed unit Gibbs scale inherited from C162; no fitted or searched scale
algorithm.probability_operator: unchanged C162 TPMO Newton/Armijo proper-measure objective
algorithm.trajectory_geometry: unchanged frozen C161 trajectories and decision mode

stopping_rule: Run one deterministic smoke and one formal evaluation per fold. Do not alter the mass-weighting rule, Gibbs scale, TPMO solver, controls, or gates after formal metrics.
claim_boundary: C165 is a retrospective train-date screen on reused C161 folds. Passing is a local mechanism result; new sealed dates or external data remain required for confirmation.
literature_limit: Targeted primary-source retrieval supports the OT and latent-permutation mechanism; it is not a systematic review or universal novelty claim.
